verdict.rationale: Make documents a full REST API with authentication/OAuth, an official TypeScript SDK, and a growing API-reference set (connections, data stores, AI agents, analytics, audit logs), plus an MCP server that explicitly lets AI systems 'view and modify scenarios and their related entities' and run/manage scenarios — supporting programmatic agent-driven workflow management. However, no explicit API-reference page for scenario create/update/activate endpoints appears in the evidence pack, so full CRUD+activate coverage for scenarios via the public API isn't directly documented. Missing for 10: an explicit scenarios.md API reference showing create/update/activate endpoints, and independent/hands-on confirmation that an agent successfully performs these actions end-to-end.
